a_long_stereo_crest_approach.full_run: success at 41.4 s, path 53.5 m (optimal 45.7 m), SPL 0.85, mean speed 1.29 m/s, 0 false stops, no mode changes; 104 debug bundles (every 2nd tick), all with the onboard image
a_long_stereo_crest_approach.description: Cruises at 1.5-1.6 m/s with R_cert 4.2-4.5 m (v_cap at the 2.0 m/s platform limit). Approaching the crest line (GT 1.8 m away at 22.2 s), MPPI's certification cost cuts the commanded speed from 1.57 to 0.06 m/s over 22.0-23.6 s (GT speed 1.60 -> 0.80 m/s); at 24.0 s, 0.2 m from the crest line, visibility collapses and the governor binds (GOV_RVIS, R = 0, v_cap 0; GT 0.43 m/s, 0.09 m/s at 24.6 s). Once the back slope is in view R_cert jumps to 6.5-7.9 m, v_cap returns to 2.0 m/s at 24.4 s and the vehicle accelerates to 1.73 m/s by 27.2 s. Caveat: the slowdown before 24.0 s is MPPI's certification term, not the governor cap (v_cap stays 2.0 until the single 24.0 s tick).
a_long_stereo_crest_approach.alternative: results/verify_dev2/stereo/FULL/103 (F2 ditch field, success at 60.1 s): ditch approach 34.8-37.2 s, the ditch is confirmed only ~1 m ahead of the body origin (R_cert 4.2 m -> 0.3 m at 35.6 s -> 0 at 36.0 s), hard stop with the body origin 0.36-0.44 m from the ditch edge (front bumper at the lip), FWD_CHECK hold 37-44 s, STOP_AND_LOOK 45.2-51.8 s, then on to the goal. It shows a late detection, not a graceful slowdown; do not narrate it as one.

b_full_vs_t1_pair.family: F3_crest_ditch (trench hidden on the back slope)
b_full_vs_t1_pair.sensor: tier0 (stereo pairs show no thesis-direction difference; see stereo_note)
b_full_vs_t1_pair.description: Same crest, same hidden trench. T1 (unknown-is-free, no negobs, no governor, 2.0 m/s) holds GT 1.85-1.88 m/s until 14.5 s and 1.63-1.76 m/s over the crest line (15.0-16.0 s); FWD_CHECK fires at 16.2 s with the trench edge 1.36 m from the body origin, too late: the front-right wheel enters the trench at 17.04 s (referee ditch_entry). FULL arrives at the crest at 1.3 m/s; at 19.8 s R_cert drops to 2.8 m (v_cap 1.93), at 20.4 s the governor binds on visibility (GOV_RVIS, R = 0, v_cap 0) and GT speed falls 1.26 -> 0.16 m/s by 21.0 s, stopping on the crest line 1.57 m from the trench edge (no ditch entry). Caveat for the narration: FULL does not reach B on this seed; it later ends 'stuck' at the world edge (52 s) because the dead-end memory is not wired into the node. Same-session fee1da9 FULL entered this trench (25.4 s).
b_full_vs_t1_pair.alternative_pair: tier0 103 (F2 ditch field): FULL reaches B at 40.9 s after threading two ditch gaps at 0.5-0.9 m/s (the slowdown is MPPI; v_cap stays 2.0); T1 holds 1.8 m/s, FWD_CHECK at 24.6 s, front-left wheel in the ditch at 25.52 s.
b_full_vs_t1_pair.stereo_note: Stereo candidates are weaker. (1) stereo 109 (F2): T1 holds 1.81 m/s toward a ditch (2.31 m away at 10.8 s), FWD_CHECK at 11.4 s, front-left wheel in the ditch at 12.38 s; FULL took a different, slower line and never came close, but it does not reach B either (timeout after 188 m). (2) stereo 117 (F4 boulder): T1 hits the rolling boulder at 14.02 s (1.19 m/s; R_cert fell 2.8 -> 1.5 -> 0 m but T1 ignores the governor); FULL reaches B at 38 s, yet the boulder passed 2.1-2.6 m to its side with v_cap at the platform limit, so the difference is route and timing, not the governor. (3) stereo 116 (F3 crest-only): T1 drives off the terrain edge (out of bounds at 20.5 s, 1.9 m/s); FULL reaches B at 62.8 s; the edge is a simulator boundary. (4) stereo 110: T1 passed the trench gap at 1.88 m/s after a health slowdown and reached B, while FULL stopped 0.89 m short of the trench at the crest (GOV_RCERT 1.8 m at 25.2 s -> GOV_RVIS 0 at 25.8 s) and then deadlocked (FWD_CHECK clr 0.03 m, the look cannot rotate).

c_health_mode_change.description: Glare starts at 12.76 s: VO inliers fall from 276 (12.6 s) to 48 (13.2 s), 20 (13.8 s) and 0 (15.0 s); q drops to 0.40 / 0.31 / 0.02. The supervisor goes NOMINAL -> DEGRADED at 13.6 s (log 'DEGRADED q=0.28'): v_cap 0.19-0.49 m/s, then hop-pause 0, and GT speed falls 1.59 -> 0.94 -> 0.37 -> 0.01 m/s by 16.2 s. VO recovers (inliers 308-357), DEGRADED -> CAUTION at 16.8 s (v_cap 1.0), CAUTION -> NOMINAL at 18.0 s, back to 1.65 m/s by 19.8 s. No FWD_CHECK or governor events in the window, so the slowdown is health only.
